title: Grateful Dead Live at Robert F. Kennedy Stadium on 1973-06-09
source: Matrix Recording From: Audience Lineage (shnid 91236): MR cassette > Nakamichi 550 > Lexicon Alpha > 48 Khz / 24-bit > USB > Samplitude 7.22 > 44.1 Khz /16-bit and SBD Lineage (shnid 172): S:MR > PCM > cassette > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN; pitch-corrected and matrixed by Monte Barry

ai_review.summary: Splendid matrix of a legendary 1973 show with jaw‑dropping Phil on Box of Rain and a monster Truckin’ jam, captured in excellent sound.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers hail this performance as one of the Dead's all‑time great shows, highlighting Phil Lesh’s stunning lead vocal on “Box of Rain” and an expansive “Truckin'” jam. The Monte Barry matrix blends a crisp soundboard feed with the venue’s delay‑tower ambience – a bit quirky at moments but overall superb.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 5‑star reviews praise both the musical performance and the matrix recording; minor quirks in the mix keep it just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Splendid matrix combining a snappy soundboard feed with delay‑tower echo; occasional odd juxtaposition but overall clear and well balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 1 reportedly ends with “Tennessee Jed”; the show flows smoothly with high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Lead vocal on Box of Rain described as jaw‑dropping; strong presence throughout the set.
